title: VC-Attention: Value Smoothing and Softmax Casting for Low-bit Attention
abstract: Diffusion Transformers deliver state-of-the-art video generation, but their long spatiotemporal sequences make attention the dominant deployment cost, and a deployable low-bit kernel must be accurate and fast. Accuracy is limited by outliers: a block's quantization scale is set by its largest entries, leaving typical entries confined to a narrow range of representable values. Prior work smooths queries and keys, but value outliers follow no fixed channel or spatiotemporal structure and remain the dominant source of output error. Speed is limited by softmax: low-bit Tensor Cores accelerate only the two matrix multiplications, so the high-precision exponential between them becomes the longest pipeline stage on datacenter GPUs. We propose VC-Attention, a training-free low-bit attention framework that addresses both by pairing Value smoothing with a fused probability Cast. V-Smooth reorders value tokens by lightweight online clustering, so the tokens in a hardware block quantize well together. It quantizes only the residual after subtracting the block mean, and restores that mean from the row sum the online softmax already maintains. ExpCast-FP8 maps log-domain scores directly to E4M3 probability codes with one fused multiply-add, eliminating the FP32 exponential and the format conversion. We implement VC-Attention for B200, B300, H200, RTX PRO 6000, and RTX 5090. Across Wan2.2, LongCat-Video, HunyuanVideo-1.5, and MiniMax-H3, VC-Attention improves fidelity over low-bit baselines, speeds up the attention kernel over BF16 FlashAttention-4 by 1.46-1.59x on datacenter Blackwell and Hopper and by 2.3-3.6x on workstation cards, and generates a clip 1.13-1.19x and 1.36-1.70x faster end to end.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Welcome to Transformer Architectures. Today's lecture is on “VC-Attention: Value Smoothing and Softmax Casting for Low-bit Attention.” We've seen a lot of recent work on making video generation more efficient, often by making attention sparse, like in 'VSA' or 'SLA'. This paper, from researchers at MIT, CMU, and Stanford, takes a different approach. Instead of changing which tokens attend to which, it reduces the cost of each attention operation itself through low-bit quantization. It's a training-free method. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 欢迎来到Transformer架构。今天的讲座是关于“VC-Attention：用于低位注意力的值平滑与Softmax类型转换”。最近我们看到很多关于提升视频生成效率的工作，通常是通过让注意力变得稀疏，比如VSA或SLA。这篇论文来自MIT、CMU和斯坦福的研究者，走了一条不同的路。它不改变哪些token关注哪些token，而是通过低位量化来降低每次注意力运算本身的成本。这是一种无需训练的方法。好，Noah？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor. Can you clarify what 'training-free' means here? Does it mean it can be applied to any pre-trained model without fine-tuning?
segments.zh: 教授您好。您能解释一下这里的“无需训练”是什么意思吗？是指它可以应用到任何预训练模型上，不需要微调吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. It's a post-hoc modification to the inference pipeline. You take an existing, fully trained video diffusion model and replace its standard attention mechanism with this more efficient, low-bit version. There's no retraining or calibration data required.
segments.zh: 没错。它是对推理流程的一种事后修改。你拿一个已经训练好的视频扩散模型，把里面标准的注意力机制换成这个更高效的低比特版本。不需要重新训练，也不需要校准数据。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: So, the core problem is that video DiTs, or Diffusion Transformers, are computationally expensive. A short, high-resolution video can have tens of thousands of tokens, and attention accounts for over 60% of the generation time. VC-Attention identifies two specific bottlenecks when trying to accelerate this with low-bit arithmetic. The first is accuracy loss from quantizing the value matrix. The second is latency from the softmax calculation, which doesn't benefit from low-bit hardware accelerators like Tensor Cores.
segments.zh: 所以核心问题在于，视频DiT，也就是扩散Transformer，计算开销非常大。一段短的高分辨率视频就可能包含数万个token，而注意力占了生成时间的60%以上。VC-Attention在尝试用低比特运算加速时，识别出了两个具体的瓶颈。第一个是对value矩阵做量化带来的精度损失。第二个是softmax计算带来的延迟，因为softmax没法从Tensor Core这类低比特硬件加速器中获益。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Wait, I thought previous methods like SageAttention already handled low-bit quantization. Why is the value matrix suddenly the main problem?
segments.zh: 等等，我记得像SageAttention这样的方法不是已经解决了低位量化的问题吗？为什么值矩阵突然成了主要问题？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That's a key insight of the paper. Previous work focused on outliers in the query and key matrices. These outliers tend to occur consistently in specific channels across many tokens, so you can fix them with channel-wise transformations. The authors argue that in video models, value outliers are different. They are token-specific. A single token might have a very large value in one channel, and that single value determines the quantization scale for a whole block of tokens, effectively crushing the precision for all the others. According to their analysis, this accounts for over 80% of the output error after applying existing Q/K fixes.
segments.zh: 这是论文的一个关键洞见。之前的工作主要关注query和key矩阵里的离群值。这些离群值往往稳定地出现在特定通道上，跨越很多token都是如此，所以可以用逐通道变换来修正。但作者认为，在视频模型里，value的离群值不一样。它们是token特有的。某个单独的token可能在某个通道上有一个非常大的值，而就是这一个值决定了整块token的量化scale，实际上把其他所有token的精度都压没了。根据他们的分析，在应用了现有的Q/K修正之后，这部分贡献了超过80%的输出误差。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Okay, that makes sense for the accuracy part. But what about the softmax latency? Is that really a bottleneck compared to the giant matrix multiplications?
segments.zh: 好，精度这部分说得通。但softmax的延迟呢？跟那些巨大的矩阵乘法比起来，它真的算瓶颈吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: On newer GPUs like the B200 and H200, yes. The low-bit matrix multiplication units have become so fast that the scalar-heavy softmax path—which involves high-precision exponentiation and then casting back to a low-bit format—can actually take longer. The hardware for matrix math has outpaced the hardware for these scalar functions, creating a new bottleneck that this paper also addresses.
segments.zh: 在B200和H200这类较新的GPU上，确实如此。低位矩阵乘法单元已经变得非常快，以至于标量运算密集的softmax路径——涉及高精度指数运算再转回低位格式——反而可能更耗时。矩阵运算硬件的进步已经超过了这些标量函数硬件的进步，由此产生了一个新的瓶颈，而这正是这篇论文也要解决的问题。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: To solve these two problems, the paper proposes a two-part methodology. The first part, called V-Smooth, addresses the value outliers. Instead of processing tokens in their original sequence, it first groups similar value tokens together using a lightweight k-means clustering. It then permutes the key and value matrices according to this new grouping. Within each block of these reordered tokens, it computes a mean vector, subtracts it out, and only quantizes the residual. The high-precision mean is then added back during the online softmax calculation without a second memory pass.
segments.zh: 为了解决这两个问题，这篇论文提出了一套分为两部分的方法。第一部分叫V-Smooth，专门处理value的离群值。它不再按原始顺序处理token，而是先用一个轻量级的k-means聚类把相似的value token归到一起，然后根据这个新的分组对key和value矩阵做重排。在每一组重排后的token块内，它计算一个均值向量，把它减掉，只对残差做量化。这个高精度的均值随后在在线softmax计算中被加回来，不需要再走一遍内存。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hold on, running k-means clustering inside every attention layer for every denoising step sounds incredibly expensive. Wouldn't that defeat the purpose of accelerating the model?
segments.zh: 等等，在每个去噪步骤的每个注意力层里都跑k-means聚类，这开销也太大了吧？那不就违背了加速模型的初衷吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A valid concern. They make it efficient in two ways. First, the k-means is warm-started from the centroids of the previous step. Second, and more importantly, they don't do it for every single step. The permutation is calculated periodically and then reused for four adjacent denoising steps, based on the assumption that token groupings don't change drastically between close steps. This amortizes the cost, reducing the overhead to just 3-4% of attention time.
segments.zh: 这个担心有道理。他们通过两种方式让它变得高效。第一，k-means是从上一步的聚类中心热启动的。第二，也是更重要的，他们并不是每一步都做。排列是周期性计算的，然后复用到相邻的四步去噪过程中，基于的假设是相邻步骤之间token的分组不会发生剧烈变化。这样就摊薄了开销，把额外成本降到了注意力时间的3%到4%。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So that handles the value problem. What about the softmax bottleneck?
segments.zh: 这样就解决了数值的问题。那softmax瓶颈呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: For that, they introduce ExpCast-FP8. This is a clever hardware-aware trick. Instead of calculating the exponential in FP32 and then converting the result to an FP8 number, it directly maps the log-domain score to an FP8 byte. It leverages the logarithmic structure of the FP8 E4M3 format. This turns an expensive exponentiation and conversion into a simple fused multiply-add and rounding operation, which is much faster. They report that the average error from this approximation is quite low, around 1.6% in total variation.
segments.zh: 为此，他们提出了ExpCast-FP8。这是一个很巧妙的硬件感知技巧。它不再用FP32计算指数，再把结果转成FP8数值，而是直接把对数域的分数映射到一个FP8字节上。它利用了FP8 E4M3格式的对数结构。这样就把一次昂贵的指数运算加转换，变成了一个简单的融合乘加和舍入操作，速度快得多。他们报告说，这种近似带来的平均误差相当低，总变差大约在1.6%。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The primary implication here is a shift in focus for low-bit attention research. It's not just about the query-key product anymore; the value matrix and the softmax implementation itself are critical sources of error and latency. This paper shows that you can address value outliers with a data-dependent grouping strategy that is still compatible with fast online attention kernels. The ExpCast method also highlights the importance of co-designing quantization algorithms with the specific numerical representations of the target hardware.
segments.zh: 这里最主要的启示是，低比特注意力研究的重心发生了转移。现在关键不只是query-key乘积，value矩阵和softmax实现本身就是误差和延迟的重要来源。这篇论文表明，可以用一种依赖数据的分组策略来处理value异常值，而且这种策略仍然兼容快速在线注意力kernel。ExpCast方法还凸显了将量化算法与目标硬件的特定数值表示进行协同设计的重要性。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So how does this relate to all the sparse attention methods we've seen, like 'Sparse VideoGen2' or 'Sol-Attn'? Are they competing approaches?
segments.zh: 那这和我们已经见过的那些稀疏注意力方法，比如Sparse VideoGen2或Sol-Attn，有什么关系呢？它们是相互竞争的方法吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That's an important distinction. They're not competing; they're orthogonal and potentially complementary. Sparse attention methods change the attention pattern itself to reduce the number of token-to-token computations. VC-Attention preserves the full, dense attention pattern. It just makes each of those computations cheaper. You could, in theory, apply V-Smooth and ExpCast on top of a model that already uses a sparse attention pattern or other efficiency techniques like few-step distillation. The paper's contribution is at the level of the arithmetic, not the architecture.
segments.zh: 这是个很重要的区别。它们不是竞争关系，而是正交的，甚至可能互补。稀疏注意力方法改变的是注意力模式本身，以减少token之间的计算量。而VC-Attention保留了完整的稠密注意力模式，只是让每一次计算都变得更便宜。理论上，你可以在一个已经使用了稀疏注意力模式或其他效率技术（比如少步蒸馏）的模型上，叠加V-Smooth和ExpCast。这篇论文的贡献在运算层面，而不在架构层面。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: To wrap up, VC-Attention provides a training-free path to accelerating video diffusion models. It does this by tackling two distinct but related problems: accuracy loss from token-specific value outliers, which it solves with V-Smooth's clustering and de-meaning, and softmax latency on modern GPUs, which it solves with the ExpCast-FP8 shortcut. The results show significant speedups—up to 1.7x end-to-end on an RTX 5090—while maintaining higher fidelity than previous low-bit methods.
segments.zh: 总结一下，VC-Attention 提供了一条无需训练就能加速视频扩散模型的路径。它解决了两个不同但相关的问题：一是 token 特定的 value 离群值导致的精度损失，它用 V-Smooth 的聚类和去均值来解决；二是现代 GPU 上的 softmax 延迟，它用 ExpCast-FP8 捷径来解决。结果显示出了显著的加速——在 RTX 5090 上端到端最高可达 1.7 倍——同时保持了比之前低比特方法更高的保真度。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The key takeaway is that efficient inference is a multi-faceted problem. Optimizing attention requires looking beyond just the query-key product and considering the unique statistical properties of the value matrix and the specific performance characteristics of the underlying hardware. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 关键结论是，高效推理是一个多维度的问题。优化注意力不能只盯着query-key乘积，还要考虑value矩阵独特的统计特性，以及底层硬件的具体性能特征。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的AI助手，或者留言评论。
